scope: Current source hashes, root references and publication counts; semantics remain required observations, no LMX parsing or execution
semantic_review: All source elements use FxSeqRead; no dense storage reinterpretation.
Selection, slicing, chunks, windows and finite cycle preserve source profile; arbitrary mapper outputs use ready-record Arrays.
Prefix scan, Maybe map and mapAccum directions reuse common engines; callbacks retain documented order and Stop policies.
Compound Maybe/Pair callback results are admitted directly, under the existing typed-result record protocol; no extra @ level is assumed.
Enumerate exact bigint index is admitted to ordinary int according to LMX_semantics.en.md descriptions/admission; conversion range failure remains ordinary.

collect uses the existing FxTry bridge; only producer Stop means exhaustion; other declared failures retain their full outcome inside FxCallFailure. Successful true-type records are appended directly; bridge/append failures keep their finite names.
Set predicates must be pure equivalence relations; order and uniqueness are explicit and Haskell list multiset subtraction is not claimed.
References preserve their original lifetime; no user object graph or activation is copied or extended.
remaining_runtime_acceptance: Typed primitive/reference/null/compound payloads and post-activation record lifetime.
Native and walker callback admission/failure channels.
Profile boundary size failures, numeric narrowing, and allocator limits.

collect_effect_review.removed: FxRecordArity (the extra record capture is no longer used)
